title: Create About Page entry fails when hero_label field is empty
expected_result: Form shows validation error for hero_label field and entry is not saved
steps_to_reproduce: Navigate to About Page content type in Admin Panel
Leave hero_label field empty or blank
prerequisites: User has access to create About Page entries

title: Remove hero_stats component from About Page entry
expected_result: Component is removed and About Page entry is saved successfully
steps_to_reproduce: Navigate to About Page content type
Open an entry with hero_stats components
Click delete/remove button on a component row
prerequisites: About Page entry has at least one hero_stats component
